meta.name: zucity-api-docs facts
meta.docsRevisionNote: inventory filter retirement (2026-08 static-delivery release): /api/inventory is a static build artifact — query params ignored, full catalog with filters:{} echo; search_inventory MCP tool filters client-side, interface unchanged; generatedAt unchanged — other values still verified against the 2026-07-03 pass
meta.verification: every value below was verified against live zucity.org HTTP responses and live eth_call reads on 2026-07-03; regenerate per release

1.name: Ethereum mainnet
1.referrerFeeBpsGetter: absent on this deployment — do not call referrerFeeBPS() on mainnet; buy/bulkBuy still accept a referrer address and the Receipt struct records referrerFee

dateEncoding.daysCount: inclusive calendar days of the stay (uint8, 1-255)
dateEncoding.availabilityBit: bit = startDay - 1; segment = floor((startDay - 1) / 182); bit set = day booked
dateEncoding.storageKey: keccak256(abi.encodePacked(uint64 listingId, uint8 year, uint256 segment))
dateEncoding.yearCross: stays crossing Dec 31 are supported; occupancy wraps into (year + 1, segment 0)

verifiedExample.observed: live Sepolia receipt id 2 sets bitmap bits 120-150 in segment 0

sentinelMeaning: items(id).minUnitPrice equal to 2^128-2 means the item is application-gated and cannot be bought directly; follow the item's externalPurchaseLink / apply flow instead

order: set totalPaid = quote on receipts[0] ONLY
purchaseRules.multiManager: encode one buy/bulkBuy per manager group and batch via multicall(bytes[])

fiat.auth: Privy JWT Bearer token (browser sessions on zucity.org are exempt)
fiat.response: single manager: {sessionId, url}; multiple managers: {sessions: [{managerAddress, sessionId, url}]}

rateLimitsPerIpPerMinute.onExceeded: HTTP 429 with Retry-After and X-RateLimit-Limit headers

rest.notes: filters AND-combined; param names case-insensitive; itemtype accepts names ticket|membership|art|merch|room|suite|villa|venue|equipment or numbers 0-10 (sponsorship=2 and service=5 are number-only); dates strict YYYY-MM-DD; cached ~60s

format = ics (default) | json | google | ical; google → 302 to https://calendar.google.com/calendar/render?cid=webcal%3A%2F%2Fzucity.org%2Fapi%2Fcalendars (Google Calendar subscribe flow); ical → 302 to webcal://zucity.org/api/calendars; json response includes chain-derived inventory[] (onchain prices in token base units, manager, booked days) and reservations[]
slug = community name or 0x wallet address (user calendar)
scraped Luma events for affiliated calendars

trpc.authHeader: Authorization: Bearer <PRIVY_JWT> (obtained by logging in at zucity.org; there are no API keys)

referral.fiatAttribution: pass referralCode in POST /api/stripe/checkout body, or call referral.attributeBooking after purchase (300 points per converted booking)
referral.onchain: pass any wallet address as the referrer argument of buy/bulkBuy; the Receipt records referrerFee; verified on Sepolia: receipts 0 and 2 each recorded exactly 10% of totalPaid as referrerFee (referrerFeeBPS = 1000)

notSupported: GET /api/inventory/{id} does not exist (404) — fetch /api/inventory and select by id client-side
POST /api/inventory returns 405 — the inventory API is read-only
no free-text search parameter — use the documented filters
no API keys and no programmatic signup — authenticated calls require a Privy session JWT from zucity.org
tRPC mutations are never called via GET
no itemsCounter() function — enumerate the registry via allItems(...) or /api/calendars?format=json
no public refund API — cancellations go through cancel(receiptId) and incur up to cancelFeeBps (30%)
items priced in JPY are fiat-path only (the JPY pay token address 0x...004A is a placeholder, not a deployed ERC20)
the REST inventory price/manager fields are display metadata and can drift from the chain — never build transactions from them

no official ZuCity bot exists on Discord, Telegram, or WhatsApp (verified absent 2026-07-22) — join the community Telegram group (urls.telegramCommunity) or Discord server (urls.discordCommunity), or run your own agent against the public surface (integrations.md § 4)
